title: Cohomology colimit cocones for bounded flat coefficient tensors
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of positive characteristic $p\ne\ell$, and separated finite-type $k$-schemes $X,Y$ [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a qcqs $k$-morphism. Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring and use the ordinary internal-module derived categories [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. Write $L=Lf_R^*$ and $G=Rf_{R*}$ with the specified internal functors of [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison]. Let $I$ be a small nonempty filtered category, $P:I\to\operatorname{Mod}_{R_Y}$ a diagram, and $(C,v)$ a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Suppose every $P_i$ and $f_R^*P_i$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and $K\in D^+(R_X)$. For each integer $q$, both cocones obtained from $(C,v)$ by the functors $M\mapsto H^q(GK\otimes^L M[0])$ and $M\mapsto H^q(G(K\otimes^L L(M[0])))$ are colimit cocones in ordinary $R_Y$-modules. In particular their legs are the images of the given $v_i$ under these exact displayed composites; no colimit in the triangulated derived category is asserted.

proof.text: Transport the given cocone through the exact module/section equivalence of [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison]. Flatness means exactness of the fixed-factor tensor functor and is preserved by this equivalence. Filtered module colimits are exact and tensor commutes with them by [lem-pc-module-filtered-colimits-tensor]. Consequently their colimit $C$ is flat. The ordinary pullback preserves the colimit by its adjunction; the same argument with the flat pulled stages shows $f_R^*C$ is flat. Represent the bounded-below $K$ by a complex vanishing below some integer $a$.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-bounded-flat-tensor-continuity] to this section-module cocone and bounded representative. Its K-flat representative of $GK$ gives a strict colimit tensor cocone representing the first displayed functor, naturally on every diagram arrow and on every specified cocone leg. Its uniformly bounded strict pulled tensor diagram and functorial K-injective replacement give an invertible localized colimit comparison to $G(K\otimes^L LC)$, with the legs of the second displayed functor.

source.place: paragraph (1), canonical scalar comparison and filtered coefficient colimits

proof.text: By [src-weil-homology-preserves-exact-colimits], homology preserves these exact filtered complex colimits. Apply it to the first strict tensor cocone and to the replacement direct-image cocone; apply homology also to the latter's invertible localized comparison. The representative isomorphisms and their leg equations give the two required colimit cocones. The exact section equivalence reflects colimits and its tensor, pullback, and pushforward comparisons carry each leg back to the internal functors, by [lem-pd-module-ringed-topos-derived-comparison].

lean.statement:
theorem filtered_flat_tensor_cohomology_cocones
    (ℓ p : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p]
    (hp : 0 < p) (hne : p ≠ ℓ)
    {X Y : Over (Scheme.Spec.obj (Opposite.op (CommRingCat.of k)))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] [QuasiCompact X.hom] [IsSeparated X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom] [QuasiCompact Y.hom] [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f.left] [QuasiSeparated f.left]
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (P : I ⥤ internalModules R Y.left) (c : Cocone P) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (hP : ∀ i : I, ObjectProperty.flat (P.obj i))
    (hfP : ∀ i : I, ObjectProperty.flat ((upperStar R f.left).obj (P.obj i)))
    (K : DerivedCategory (internalModules R X.left)) (hK : ∃ n : ℤ, K.IsGE n) :
    ∀ q : ℤ,
      Nonempty (IsColimit
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (internalModules R Y.left) 0 ⋙
          (derivedTensor R Y.left).obj ((internalDerivedPushforward R f.left).obj K) ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (internalModules R Y.left) q).mapCocone c)) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (internalModules R Y.left) 0 ⋙
          internalDerivedPullback R f.left ⋙ (derivedTensor R X.left).obj K ⋙
          internalDerivedPushforward R f.left ⋙
          DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (internalModules R Y.left) q).mapCocone c))
